fields.mechanism: feedback loop bias amplification in collaborative filtering systems
fields.intervention: implement a debiasing algorithm that periodically resets the training data with a small random sample of cold-start user interactions
fields.expected_effect: maintain recommendation diversity by preventing the system from over-optimizing on its own feedback, preserving long-term engagement for mid-tail users while maintaining high request throughput
fields.falsification_test: compare retention rates between users exposed to the debiased system versus the original system over a 90-day period
fields.mechanism_source_span: "collaborative filtering systems can develop feedback loops where the system's own recommendations influence future training data, leading to reduced diversity and potential bias amplification"
